* mu. Cas.label: Mu Cas A
* mu. Cas.scope: Primary Mu Cas A, not the total mass of the binary or the faint B component. The catalog retains the existing Mu Cas system marker and motion.
* mu. Cas.note: Bond et al. 2020: primary dynamical mass (Table 7), photospheric [Fe/H] (Table 9), preferred temperature and luminosity (§9.1), and model age (§9.2). Radius is the parallax-adjusted interferometric value in Table 9. The paper suspects the interferometric angular diameter is overestimated by a few percent, and explicitly treats temperature, radius, helium content and age as uncertain. The adopted surface [Fe/H]=-0.81 differs from the initial abundance used for diffusion-inclusive stellar models. Luminosity and mass use this paper's parallax and are retained as published, not recomputed with the catalog's orbit-contaminated Gaia component parallax.

radius_solar.caveat: Formal uncertainty excludes the suspected angular-diameter systematic; see §8.1.

age_gyr.caveat: Suggestive model estimate sensitive to temperature, angular diameter, helium and element diffusion.

* rho Per.label: Rho Persei (Gorgonea Tertia)
* rho Per.note: Tables 2-3, row E: direct granulation-scaling mass and Stefan-Boltzmann radius; luminosity converts log10(L/Lsun)=3.43 +/-0.03, adopted there from McDonald et al. 2017. Published values retain their source temperature (3479 +/-125 K); the catalog's existing spectroscopic temperature and [Fe/H] remain unchanged. Mass is not an orbital/dynamical measurement; radius is not interferometric. No age is adopted because this paper reports none.

mass_solar.caveat: Empirical granulation calibration and the paper's radius; not a dynamical mass.

luminosity_solar.caveat: McDonald et al. 2017 SED value as adopted by Kallinger; retained at the publication's distance.

radius_solar.caveat: Published radius uses 3479 K, not the catalog's preserved 3619 K temperature.
